subject.title: refactor(config): retire flat and scalar streaming keys from matrix, feishu, and qqbot

question: After the QQBot regression is fixed and real upgrade proof is supplied, should this release intentionally reject legacy Matrix, Feishu, and QQBot streaming spellings at startup until doctor --fix migrates them?
rationale: This intentionally changes accepted user configuration across three bundled channels; automated checks can validate mappings, but a human must accept the operator-facing upgrade policy and release timing.

options.title: Land after fix and proof
options.body: Preserve the nested-only schemas, fix the QQBot mixed-state behavior, and accept the one-time doctor migration after live upgrade evidence is reviewed.

options.title: Keep tolerance one train
options.body: Continue accepting old spellings temporarily while doctor warns and migrates, reducing upgrade disruption but extending dual configuration behavior.

options.title: Split channel migrations
options.body: Land only channels with accepted upgrade proof and defer the remaining schema retirement to narrower follow-ups.

recommendation.title: Land after fix and proof
recommendation.body: Preserve the nested-only schemas, fix the QQBot mixed-state behavior, and accept the one-time doctor migration after live upgrade evidence is reviewed.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior merged streaming-retirement series and its compatibility decisions are concentrated in this contributor's history.
